Subject: Proposed autoscale & burst policy + fallback matrix (EmberTech)

Hi Sofia / Liam — following up with a concrete proposal so you can review with Ops/security. I put the key points first and then a short fallback matrix. Attached: regional_capacity_matrix.xlsx.

Proposal (baseline):
- Baseline pool: 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs (reserved).
- Autoscaling: scale up by 1 GPU when active concurrent sessions > 120 OR average token throughput > 60k tokens/min for 3 consecutive minutes.
- Burst: allow short-lived burst to 12 GPUs subject to burst budget of 500 GPU-minutes per day; bursts are first-fit within the primary region.
- Cooling: scale-down delay = 10 minutes after throughput drops below thresholds.
- Cache priming: automatic prefix/KV priming for pinned prompts during scheduled canary windows.

Fallback & regional failover matrix (simplified):
1) Detect sustained latency > 300ms p50 for 2 minutes AND CPU/GPU utilization > 85% -> trigger local scale-up if capacity available.
2) If local region saturated and burst budget exhausted -> route new traffic to eu-west warm standby with session affinity window = 60s.
3) For full-region outage -> global reroute to eu-west and notify both teams via PagerDuty; degrade model to smaller quantized variant if needed to keep latency below 500ms.

Operational notes for your security team: tenant isolation on cache, KMS-managed keys for model state, and audit logs for inference requests retained per your compliance window (we'll set retention to match your policy).

Open questions for EmberTech (please reply inline):
- Expected 95th percentile tokens per session? (Liam/Sofia)
- Any blackout windows for scheduled maintenance Nov 10-12?

I'll get Marissa to draft the canary schedule; Rishi will scope the runbook for cutover.

Thanks,
Monica Patel

Subject: Dedicated activation plan, canary schedule, and runbook snippet (final)

Hi all — quick sync following the inputs from EmberTech. Below is the proposed activation plan and a short runbook snippet for cutover. We're aiming for go-live prep week of Nov 15 with a canary on Nov 10 (non-business hours).

Activation timeline (high level):
- Nov 10 02:00-04:00 PT: Canary (10% traffic) to validate KV priming and model latencies; engineers on call from both sides.
- Nov 13-14: Final smoke tests and configuration freeze.
- Nov 16 01:00-05:00 PT: Production cutover; progressive ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%) over 2 hours.

Runbook snippet (cutover) - key steps:
1) Pre-cutover validation: ensure baseline 4-GPU pool health, confirm KMS keys, validate prefix cache contents and model variant pinned.
2) Start canary: route 10% traffic using header routing; verify p50 latency < 300ms and error rate < 0.5%.
3) If metrics pass for 20 minutes, increment to 50% for 30 minutes. If any stage fails, rollback to previous traffic split and engage incident channel.
4) On full cutover, enable burst budget and monitor GPU utilization; if utilization > 80% for >10 minutes, scale out one GPU and notify EmberTech ops.

Notes on session affinity and DR: we will preserve session affinity where possible by routing based on session token mapping. If a full-region failover occurs, new sessions will be routed to eu-west; existing sessions may lose affinity if state cannot be synchronized within the affinity window (60s). We will provide a short client-side guidance doc to handle re-auth and session rehydration.

Attachments: tech-runbook-snippet.txt (short excerpt).

- EmberTech: confirm tokens/session numbers above match your telemetry (Liam/Sofia).
- Vanessa / Monica / Marissa: I'll post the full runbook draft to SUP-1492 and invite for review by Oct 8.
